primary_goal: Guide visitors to featured promotional campaigns, top category deals, and product detail pages to initiate purchases.

friction_points.issue: Primary Call-to-Action buttons lack visual contrast and dominance.
friction_points.evidence: Buttons like 'Zur Aktion', 'Zum Produkt', and 'Zum Angebot' use transparent/white backgrounds with thin black outlines instead of high-contrast solid brand colors, making them easy to overlook against white card containers.

friction_points.issue: Product recommendation cards lack direct 'In den Warenkorb' (Add to Cart) action buttons.
friction_points.evidence: Cards under 'Top-Empfehlungen für dich' and 'Aktuell beliebt' display ratings, prices, and shipping info, but force users to click through to product pages to purchase.

friction_points.issue: Hero image uses abstract AI graphics ('Generiert mit KI') instead of actual recognizable hero products.
friction_points.evidence: Hero image shows floating ghost-like gadgets with '-60%' text rather than tangible flagship products, reducing visual appeal and immediate clarity of the offer.

friction_points.issue: German key trust drivers (payment options, free shipping badges, security seals) are buried low in the page.
friction_points.evidence: Payment logos (PayPal, Klarna, Purchase on Invoice/Consors) and shipping icons appear only at the very bottom above the footer text wall (Screenshots 8-9).

friction_points.issue: Excessive legal text block creates an extremely long page scroll.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshots 10 and 11 consist entirely of dense legal disclaimers and fine print covering terms for financing, Halloween deals, and returns.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add solid primary 'In den Warenkorb' (Add to Cart) buttons to product cards in 'Top-Empfehlungen' and 'Aktuell beliebt', then add-to-cart rate will increase because shoppers can buy immediately without navigating away.
hypotheses.change: Add a prominent direct Add-to-Cart button on hover/card view for featured products.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we change secondary outlined CTA buttons ('Zur Aktion', 'Zum Angebot') to high-contrast solid buttons, then promo CTR will increase because the visual hierarchy will clearly guide user attention.
hypotheses.change: Style campaign CTAs with solid dark red or black backgrounds and white text.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we feature top payment methods (PayPal, Klarna, 0% Finanzierung) in a sticky top header bar, then conversion rate will improve because trust and financial flexibility are communicated immediately.
hypotheses.change: Add small payment logos (PayPal, Klarna) directly into the top USPs bar next to '0% Finanzierung'.

quick_wins: Change transparent outline CTA buttons ('Zur Aktion') to solid high-contrast buttons.
Add key payment logos (PayPal, Klarna) near the top header search bar/USP bar for instant German trust alignment.
Collapse dense legal disclaimers in the footer into an expandable 'Rechtliche Hinweise' accordion.
uncertainties: Whether product mockups (e.g., 'iPhone 18 Pro', 'Switch 2') are placeholder test data or staging environment content.
Click-through rates of the top 'KI-Suche' toggle in the search header.
Mobile vs desktop traffic distribution for this layout.
